panels.description: Bua-ji holds the marked equipment fragment over a table while Guddu compares its service number with a loose contractor carbon copy outside his permit folder. The folder remains full of wrong permits and miscellaneous copies. Keep upper-left clear.
Duda perches on a cement bag above the group, delivering a careful limitation to his testimony. Keep the upper third open.
Moti stands beside the recovered dhurrie, one ear up, while the other four dogs guard the route behind him. Keep road and sky space clear.
Back inside GODARAZ, Billi returns to the empty ball return opposite Duda’s lane-3 perch. She accepts no thanks. Keep the upper-left interior clear.

items.speaker: DUDA
items.text: I saw the goons take the galeecha. I did not hear the whole plan. I am a truthful bird.
